symptom: PCs in VLAN 10 cannot reach each other
topology_note: Access ports Fa0/1 and Fa0/2 should be in VLAN 10 on SW1

SW1#show vlan brief
VLAN Name                             Status    Ports
---- -------------------------------- --------- -------------------------------
1    default                          active    Fa0/1, Fa0/2, Fa0/3
10   USERS                            active    Fa0/10, Fa0/11
